title: Elemental Paintings
body:
Adds the unused paintings these paintings were originally added to Pocket Edition as part of a promotional map meant to be shown at MINECON 2012 or 2013

This mod doesn't change any game play it simply adds paintings!


From: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Painting#Unused_paintings

Curseforge Page: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/elemental-paintings
